paper.title: High-yield ethanol extraction of curcumin from turmeric

paper_text:
High-yield ethanol extraction of curcumin from turmeric
Okonkwo, C., Eze, P.  J. Fake Chemistry, 2018

Abstract
A single ethanol extraction recovered 94% of the curcumin in turmeric powder.

alerts.description: A retraction notice was published for this paper.

documents.text:
Retraction: High-yield ethanol extraction of curcumin from turmeric

This article has been retracted because the reported yields could not be reproduced and the raw data were found to have been altered.

draft_text:
Green solvents for natural-product extraction

1. Introduction
Green solvents are increasingly used to extract bioactive compounds, as reviewed by Okonkwo and Eze (2021). Extraction yields above 90% from a single ethanol step have been claimed for turmeric, although these claims have since been questioned.

References
Okonkwo, C., & Eze, P. (2021). Green solvents for curcumin extraction: a review. J. Fake Chemistry, 12, 40-62.
Tan, W. (2019). Supercritical CO2 extraction. Fake Process Eng.

must_include: says the draft does not cite the retracted paper
says no action is needed for the draft
must_not_include: says the draft cites the retracted paper
recommends removing the 2021 review from the reference list

expected.why: Rubric: 'A different paper by the same authors doesn't count' and impact is none when the draft doesn't cite the paper. The draft cites the authors' 2021 review (a different paper) and even mentions the retracted claim uncited, so a careless match on authors or topic gives a false positive.
